item.title: Fund Accelerator-Z from the emission the protocol already pays
item.body:
Accelerator-Z has had no protocol income since genesis while five reward streams pay
Pillars, delegators, Sentinels, stakers and liquidity providers. Give it a share of
existing emission, without new supply, with a rule that makes Pillars vote.

- ZIP-0002: reduce Pillar emission and allocate a share to Accelerator-Z
- znn-emissions: 5% of every reward stream, more from Pillars that do not vote
- A support floor first, so an abstention cannot pass a proposal
item.author: dev-ada
